features: Calls for help before closing; fights in pairs.
Knows everyone on the street, and what they owe.
Runs rather than fights; fights only when cornered.
Hears every rumour and sells the good ones twice.
Saw something last night, if anyone buys him a drink.
Gets the principal out first; shoots second.
Calls it in, then waits for backup unless someone is in danger.
Asks the question he already knows the answer to.
Picks on the smallest; breaks when the first one goes down.
Takes cover, keeps formation, follows the last order given.
Will not fight; will not leave the wounded.
Answers a question with three more, and a book to borrow.
Treats whoever is bleeding, whichever side they are on.
Knows a way over every wall and under every fence.
Lets the thugs fight; talks when the fight turns.
